_note: Copy to config.local.json (or run npm run setup). Rules not listed here come from profiles/<profile>/profile.json; copy a key here to override it. lang: "en" or "zh".
_level: entry (new grad, early career), mid (about 2–5 years) or senior (5+ years). Adjusts the profile's title and years rules.

locations._states: Optional: whole US states, as "CA" or "California". A job anywhere in one of them counts like one of your cities.
locations.label: Local

_maxAgeDays: Hide postings first posted more than this many days ago (postings with no date are kept). The report also has a Posted filter.
